_comment: Per-app override deep-merged onto josh-approved-factory/templates/privacy/privacy-declarations.json by push-privacy-forms.mjs. packing-list turns OFF one accessibility claim the studio default asserts, because it is not true here yet — the reason and evidence are the 'Not claimed' block in STORE_LISTING.md § Accessibility Nutrition Labels (re-verified 2026-08-09). Claiming it on the App Store product page would be a false accessibility claim, which is worse than claiming nothing. Flip it back to true in the SAME change that fixes and re-verifies it. Voice Control and Larger Text were earned on 2026-08-09 and are now claimed.

accessibility._comment: supportsSufficientContrast: NARROW. Every app-owned surface now clears WCAG — the packed-item-name failure was fixed 2026-07-21 (fb0ed2c), and on 2026-08-09 the app's own placeholders (add-item bar, trip name) and interactive icons (drag handle, resync) moved off fgSubtle to fgMuted (5.06:1 light / 7.13:1 dark). What remains is the fgSubtle token itself at 2.68:1 light / 3.72:1 dark, still used by SEVEN factory-synced shared components this app cannot fix without forking them: two placeholders (Dialogs, FeedbackSheet), the feedback log checkbox, and four disclosure chevrons (AboutRow, MoreFromJA, LanguageSetting, FeedbackTypePicker). Disabled-state uses (Stepper, the empty add button) are exempt under WCAG 1.4.3/1.4.11 and are fine. Fix belongs in josh-approved-factory/templates; defect packing-list-20260809-2.
